versions.changelog:
Initial release — provides comprehensive race pace prediction and training guidance based on one recent race time.

- Predicts equivalent race times at all standard distances using Riegel's model.
- Calculates personalized training paces (easy, long, marathon, threshold, interval, repetition).
- Assesses realism of specific goal times and suggests phase structure for a training block.
- Builds safe weekly mileage ramps with built-in cutback weeks (10%-rule).
- Prints even-split tables for race day pacing.
- Supports both kilometer and mile units.
